name: commafy
title: Commafy
description: Format numbers in any text selection: insert or remove thousand separators, normalize full-width digits, or render in Japanese 万/億 units — while skipping decimals, phone numbers, dates, and year tokens by default.
author: zaaaato

commands.name: commafy
commands.title: Commafy Selection
commands.subtitle: Format Numbers
commands.description: Insert thousand-separator commas into integers in the selected text.

preferences.name: minDigits
preferences.title: Minimum Digits
preferences.description: Minimum integer-part digit count before commas are inserted.

preferences.name: separator
preferences.title: Separator
preferences.description: Character used as the thousands separator.

preferences.name: includeDecimals
preferences.title: Format Decimals
preferences.description: Also format the integer portion of decimal numbers. When the separator is a period this is disabled to avoid ambiguity.
preferences.label: Also commafy the integer portion of decimal numbers

preferences.name: excludeYears
preferences.title: Exclude Years
preferences.description: Skip Japanese year tokens (xxxx年). Years rarely benefit from thousand separators.
preferences.label: Skip Japanese year tokens (xxxx年)

preferences.name: excludeHyphenated
preferences.title: Exclude Hyphenated
preferences.description: Skip hyphen- and slash-separated digit groups (phone numbers, yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd).
preferences.label: Skip phone numbers and date-style numbers (yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd)

preferences.name: normalizeFullWidth
preferences.title: Normalize Full-Width
preferences.description: Convert full-width digits (０-９) and numeric punctuation (．，－) to half-width before formatting.
preferences.label: Convert full-width digits (１２３) to half-width before formatting

commands.name: decommafy
commands.title: Decommafy Selection
commands.subtitle: Remove Separators
commands.description: Strip thousand-separator commas from numbers in the selected text.

preferences.name: separator
preferences.title: Separator to Remove
preferences.description: The thousands separator character to strip. Period is intentionally excluded because it conflicts with decimal points.

commands.name: normalize-digits
commands.title: Normalize Full-Width Digits
commands.description: Convert full-width digits (０-９) and numeric punctuation (．，－) in the selected text to half-width.

commands.name: commafy-japanese
commands.title: Commafy with 万/億
commands.subtitle: Japanese Units
commands.description: Format integers in the selected text using Japanese myriad units (万, 億, 兆).

preferences.name: withInternalCommas
preferences.title: Internal Commas
preferences.description: Place commas inside each 4-digit unit group for additional readability.
preferences.label: Also place commas inside each 4-digit unit group (1,234万5,678)

preferences.name: excludeHyphenated
preferences.title: Exclude Hyphenated
preferences.description: Skip hyphen- and slash-separated digit groups (phone numbers, yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd).
preferences.label: Skip phone numbers and date-style numbers (yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd)

preferences.name: normalizeFullWidth
preferences.title: Normalize Full-Width
preferences.description: Convert full-width digits (０-９) and numeric punctuation (．，－) to half-width before formatting.
preferences.label: Convert full-width digits (１２３) to half-width before formatting

commands.name: preview-commafy
commands.title: Preview Commafy
commands.subtitle: Before / After
commands.description: Show a before/after preview of the Commafy and 万/億 results before applying.

preferences.name: minDigits
preferences.title: Minimum Digits
preferences.description: Minimum integer-part digit count before commas are inserted.

preferences.name: separator
preferences.title: Separator
preferences.description: Character used as the thousands separator in the Commafy preview.

preferences.name: includeDecimals
preferences.title: Format Decimals
preferences.description: Also format the integer portion of decimal numbers in the Commafy preview.
preferences.label: Also commafy the integer portion of decimal numbers

preferences.name: excludeYears
preferences.title: Exclude Years
preferences.description: Skip Japanese year tokens (xxxx年) in both previews.
preferences.label: Skip Japanese year tokens (xxxx年)

preferences.description: Skip hyphen- and slash-separated digit groups (phone numbers, yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd).
